source_en: The souls of the Fallen, are prisoners within my mind.
final_ar: أرواح الساقطين سجينة في عقلي.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: The city, Mathias, the Egregore, myself. Now carrion for the Garden.
final_ar: المدينة، وماثياس، والإيغريغور، وأنا. الآن، جميعنا جيف للحديقة.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Amusing display.
final_ar: عرض مسلٍ.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Ahh, from annals of legend itself.
final_ar: آه، هذا مستلّ من سجلات الأساطير ذاتها.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Shattered Coil or no. War's been the only constant in these long ages past.
final_ar: سواءً كانت "اللفيفة المحطّمة" أم لا، فقد كانت الحرب هي الثابت الوحيد في هذه العصور الطويلة الخالية.
reason: fixed the feminine agreement and replaced the ungrammatical noun-noun pileup with a real adjective phrase for Shattered Coil; the Coil is still a pending glossary term.

source_en: Pathetic display.
final_ar: عرض مثير للشفقة.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Man nor Angel cannot withstand the tide of war.
final_ar: لا إنسان ولا ملاك يقوى على صولة الحرب.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Like a brilliant flame your fury is gone.
final_ar: كشعلة ساطعة، قد خمدت ثورتك.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Here. Fine Karsivite dragon forged weapon. Reminds Gajov of home.
final_ar: خذ. سلاح مطروق من تنين كارسيفي. يذكر قاجوف بالوطن.
reason: correct demonym and the right verb for forging a weapon; final_ar also moves the participle next to the noun it modifies.

source_en: Now, kill gods.
final_ar: الآن، اقتل آلهة.
reason: English is an imperative, so the verbal noun had to become the command form.

source_en: Dragon bones were highly sought after by Karsivites. Allow Gajov to show you why.
final_ar: عظام التنين كانت مطلوبة جداً عند الكارسيفيين. دع قاجوف يريك السبب.
reason: restored past tense and used a real Arabic plural demonym for Karsivites.

source_en: Bring Gajov what he need and Gajov help.
final_ar: أحضر لقاجوف ما يحتاج وقاجوف يساعد.
reason: corrected a non-existent imperative form and matched the identical English line elsewhere.

source_en: Good pup. Now, buy new toy. Kill gods.
final_ar: جرو جيد. الآن، اشترِ لعبة جديدة. اقتل آلهة.
reason: buy was mistranslated as fetch, and the second clause needed the imperative that Gajov's command tone requires.

source_en: Gajov need much infernal energy or no reforge for Lady Mereda.
final_ar: قاجوف يحتاج طاقة جهنّمية كثيرة أو لا إعادة صهر للسيدة ميريدا.
reason: restored the shadda used in the approved glossary spelling of the infernal term.

source_en: Bring Gajov material... Gajov forge blade!...
final_ar: أحضر لقاجوف مواد… قاجوف يطرق نصل!…
reason: added the preposition so the line reads bring materials to Gajov rather than bring Gajov.

source_en: Gajov seen many clergy fall victim to vampirism. Many by his own fangs. Hmm. The Cardinal's staff intrigues Gajov. Help him reforge it.
final_ar: قاجوف رأى كثير من رجال الدين يتحوّلون إلى مصاصي دماء. كثير منهم بأنيابه هو. همم. عصا الكاردينال تثير فضول قاجوف. ساعده في إعادة صهرها.
reason: fall victim to vampirism means being turned, which restores the causal link to the next sentence about his own fangs.

source_en: That Beast. Warden. Its strength is still of use. Help Gajov forge a mighty weapon from it. It will be yours.
final_ar: ذلك الوحش. الحارس. قوته لا تزال نافعة. ساعد قاجوف على صهر سلاح عظيم منه. سيكون لك.
reason: corrected the idiomatic preposition for helping someone do something.

source_en: This what I need.
final_ar: هذا ما يحتاجه قاجوف.
reason: the draft's pronoun had no antecedent and read as he needs it; naming Gajov matches his third-person self-reference.

source_en: Fetch pup, fetch.
final_ar: أحضر، أيها الجرو، أحضر.
reason: Fetch is an imperative, not a verbal noun.

source_en: No touch sword! ...Not ready. More hit.
final_ar: لا تلمس سيف! …ليس جاهزاً. ضربات أكثر.
reason: dropping the article matches Gajov's clipped English, but deleting the alif from the predicate of laysa leaves a plain grammatical error, so final_ar restores it.

source_en: Mereda? Hmm. Let Gajov see.
final_ar: ميريدا؟ همم. دع قاجوف يرى.
reason: restored the causative Let Gajov see that the English has.

source_en: No talk. Always talk. Always lies.
final_ar: لا كلام. كلام دائم. أكاذيب دائمة.
reason: a broken plural takes a feminine singular adjective.

source_en: I ain't openin' m'door just ta die polite.
final_ar: لن أفتح بابي لأموت بأدب فحسب.
reason: the draft dropped the dying, which is the whole point of the line.

source_en: (whimpering fear)
final_ar: (أنين من الخوف)
reason: stage cues are noun phrases in this project, not conjugated verbs.

source_en: I thought you magnificent... a visionary... the darling of the entire city. And yet you present me with a peasant’s band? Keep your miserable proposal! Take your wretched seal as well. I stole it from you at the gala when you weren't looking! The great Solomon... undone by his own admirers.
final_ar: ظننتُكَ عظيماً… صاحب رؤية… محبوب المدينة بأسرها. ومع ذلك، تقدم لي خاتم فلاح؟ احتفظ باقتراحك البائس! وخذ ختمك الحقير أيضاً. لقد سرقتُه منك في الحفل حين غفلتَ عني! سولومون العظيم… أرداه معجبوه.
reason: the duplicated noun was garbled and is now fixed; final_ar also drops three vocative particles the English has no vocative for, renders band as a ring, and uses undone rather than insulted.

source_en: A proper proposal deserves a proper jewel. Something radiant... something the whole court would whisper about.
final_ar: العرض اللائق يستحق جوهرةً لائقة. شيئاً متألقاً… شيئاً تتهامس به كل أرجاء البلاط.
reason: the draft attached an accusative adjective to a genitive noun; final_ar keeps the editor's clean rebuild but drops the new decorative case vowel.

source_en: Oi, scram. You'll blow my cover.
final_ar: أوي، انصرف من هنا. ستكشف أمري.
reason: the draft's interjection was a homograph of the pronoun she.

source_en: What Solomon's spire did to your soul, broke your chains. Now you are unstoppable. You could leave the Order should you choose,
final_ar: إن ما فعله برج سولومون بروحك قد كسر قيودك. أنت الآن لا يمكن إيقافك. يمكنك مغادرة الجماعة إن شئت،
reason: Spire is a locked glossary term and the verb now agrees with it.

source_en: My my child. You are delightfully... sinful. Bearer of the sins of your progenitors.
final_ar: يا للعجب يا بني. أنت… آثم بشكل مبهج. حاملٌ لخطايا أسلافك.
reason: My my is a surprise interjection, not a doubled vocative.

source_en: Once I taught that virtue was ideal. Like the Divine himself who took on the plight of mankind to guide us through the darkness under his holy moonlight.
final_ar: ذات يوم، كنتُ أُعلّم أن الفضيلة هي الغاية الأسمى. تماماً كالإله الذي تحمل آلام البشرية ليقودنا عبر الظلمات تحت ضوء قمره المقدس.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: I guess the new owners just left me in here, and judging by the sounds of things out there, good for me!
final_ar: أظن أن المُلّاك الجدد تركوني هنا، وبالنظر إلى الأصوات التي أسمعها في الخارج، فهذا أمر جيد لي!
reason: shadda disambiguates owners from angel; final_ar also fixes the malformed verb plus pronoun.

source_en: Sorry friend. Only enough room for one and my chamber pot! Hehehe!
final_ar: عذراً يا صديقي. لا يوجد مكان إلا لشخص واحد ولقصريتي! هيهيهي!
reason: chamber pot was rendered as mirror, and the apology is now gender-neutral for a speaker of unknown gender.

source_en: I earned this cell! You hear me?! How many souls and broken bones—worth it. All of it worth it!
final_ar: لقد استحققتُ هذه الزنزانة! أتسمعني؟! كم من الأرواح والعظام المحطمة—كلها تستحق. كل شيء يستحق!
reason: removed an awkward double hamza in favour of the natural interrogative.

source_en: Mine! I've me own luxury suite in hell 'alf breed! Hahaha!
final_ar: ملكي! لدي جناحي الفاخر الخاص في الجحيم يا هجين! ههههه!
reason: half-breed is the specific insult the card asks to preserve; the draft's word means bastard.

source_en: Had a habit of finding myself in this box. Before Nachstahl Steel took over, back when this place was owned by the Caldewels.
final_ar: اعتدتُ أن أجد نفسي في هذا الصندوق. قبل أن تستولي "ناختشتال ستيل" عليه، عندما كان هذا المكان ملكاً لعائلة "كالدويل".
reason: restored the glossary-locked spelling of the Nachtstahl name.

source_en: Every Nephilim in this Order is here because I asked them to be.
final_ar: كل نيفيليم في هذه الجماعة موجود هنا لأنني طلبت منهم ذلك.
reason: the demonstrative must agree with the feminine noun for the Order.

source_en: The Order is stronger for what you've done today.
final_ar: أصبحت الجماعة أقوى بفضل ما أنجزته اليوم.
reason: the draft lost the Order entirely and the verb now agrees.

source_en: Done. The Order is stronger for it.
final_ar: تم الأمر. لقد أصبحت الجماعة أقوى بفضلك.
reason: feminine subject needs the feminine verb.

source_en: Three times? I'm not counting to four.
final_ar: ثلاث مرات؟ لن أعدّ حتى أربعة.
reason: four is a bare numeral here, so the definite article was wrong.

source_en: What you've become - the Church has no name for it. I do. It's called whole.
final_ar: ما أصبحت عليه - لا اسم له عند الكنيسة. أما أنا فلي اسم: الكامل.
reason: removed a doubled prepositional phrase and the padding that Gallant's terse voice forbids.

source_en: Sunder. Don't let the power outpace your discipline.
final_ar: ساندر. لا تدع القوة تتجاوز انضباطك.
reason: Sunder reads as a Weapon Art name here, and the draft's imperative carried an object pronoun with no antecedent.

source_en: Your last excursion, that is what this Order is made of.
final_ar: جولتك الأخيرة - هذا ما تُصنع منه هذه الجماعة.
reason: is made of is essence, not founding; final_ar also uses the approved glossary term for Excursion.

source_en: Well earned. Don't let it make you careless.
final_ar: مُستحَقّ. لا تدع ذلك يجعلك مهملاً.
reason: the draft was a tautology of earning that is earned.

source_en: I've stopped counting the dead, but their names I'll never forget.
final_ar: لقد توقفت عن عدّ الموتى، لكنني لن أنسى أسماءهم أبداً.
reason: fixed a typo that turned counting into except.

source_en: If the Spire falls... maybe then. Maybe then we can rest.
final_ar: إذا سقط البرج… ربما حينها. ربما حينها يمكننا الراحة.
reason: the Spire is masculine, so the verb had to change.

source_en: Get out there! The sooner we know what's sustaining the spire's influence the sooner we can reach those stones.
final_ar: انطلق! كلما أسرعنا في معرفة ما يُبقي نفوذ البرج قائماً، أسرعنا في الوصول إلى تلك الأحجار.
reason: the draft's past tense contradicted the forward-looking the sooner, the sooner structure.

source_en: They say the Librarian was sanctioned at Quorum. They do not say what was sanctioned.
final_ar: يقولون إن أمينة المكتبة قد عوقبت في "كوروم". ولا يقولون ما هو العقاب الذي نالها.
reason: cleaned up a doubled vowel in the Quorum transliteration.

source_en: Half the books in that library are not the books we tell the Faith they are. By now, Nephilim, I expect you have learned which is which.
final_ar: نصف الكتب في تلك المكتبة ليست هي الكتب التي نخبر الإيمان بأنها كذلك. حتى الآن، يا نيفيليم، أتوقع أنك تعلمت التمييز بينها.
reason: by now refers to elapsed time, which the draft's phrase reversed.

source_en: We have noticed, Nephilim, that the Merchant is happier on the days you visit.
final_ar: لقد لاحظنا، أيها النيفيليم، أن التاجر يكون أكثر سعادةً في الأيام التي تزوره فيها.
reason: the player visits the Merchant, not the monks.

source_en: The barrier is thin. The Sanctus is colder for it. I had not believed it could be colder.
final_ar: الحاجز واهن. السانكتوس أكثر برودة بسبب ذلك. لم أكن أؤمن أنه يمكن أن يكون أكثر برودة.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: I had a system, Nephilim.
final_ar: كان لدي نظام، يا نيفيليم.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Our lord bleeds over the cursed city. A dire omen to be sure!
final_ar: سيدنا ينزف فوق المدينة الملعونة. إنه نذير شؤم مؤكد!
reason: tanween strip is correct; final_ar completes it by removing the remaining case vowels and fixes the pronoun to agree with the masculine omen.

source_en: The smith is loud. The smith is always loud. The smith likes the noise.
final_ar: الحداد صاخب. الحداد صاخب دائما. الحداد يحبّ الضجيج.
reason: tanween strip is correct; final_ar removes the leftover case vowels the same rule forbids and keeps only the shadda.

source_en: The Knight returned safely. I have begun to count the times the Knight returned... different.
final_ar: عاد الفارس بسلام. لقد بدأتُ في عدّ المرات التي عاد فيها الفارس… متغيرا.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: The War Table is rarely free of you and the Commander these days, Nephilim. The other Knights wait their turn. Some have begun to ask aloud why their turn is taking so long, and I am running out of comfortable answers.
final_ar: نادرا ما تخلو طاولة الحرب منك ومن القائد هذه الأيام، يا نيفيليم. الفرسان الآخرون ينتظرون دورهم. بدأ البعض يتساءلون بصوت عال عن سبب تأخر دورهم، وبدأت إجاباتي المريحة تنفد.
reason: tanween strip is correct; final_ar also removes a leftover case vowel the same rule forbids.

source_en: Be careful what you accept from the Merchant, Nephilim. His prices are not, as a rule, written on his receipts, and you have been visiting often enough now that I suspect you have begun to understand this.
final_ar: كن حذرا مما تقبله من التاجر، يا نيفيليم. فأسعاره، كقاعدة عامة، لا تُدوّن في وصولاته، وقد زرتَه مرات كافية حتى أظن أنك بدأت تفهم ذلك.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: A man who reads by candlelight is half-blind. A man who reads by moonlight sees what the candle hid.
final_ar: الرجل الذي يقرأ على ضوء الشموع نصف أعمى. والرجل الذي يقرأ على ضوء القمر يرى ما أخفته الشمعة.
reason: the draft's half-blind phrase does not parse, and wax was used where the candle was meant.

source_en: If the Faith intended my dismemberment by the Knights, Nephilim, the Faith would have informed me.
final_ar: لو كان الإيمان ينوي تمزيقي على يد الفرسان، يا نيفيليم، لكان الإيمان قد أخبرني بذلك.
reason: the Faith is masculine here, so the feminine verbs were wrong.

source_en: The Knight visits the Librarian often. I am told this is the Order's business and not the Faith's.
final_ar: يزور الفارس أمينة المكتبة كثيرا. قيل لنا إن هذا من شؤون الجماعة وليس من شؤون الإيمان.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: The font was dry at vespers and full by matins. I did not refill it.
final_ar: كان الجرن جافا عند صلاة المساء وممتلئا عند صلاة الفجر. لم أقم بملئه.
reason: tanween strip is correct; final_ar also renders font as the baptismal basin rather than a spring.

source_en: Mereda keeps a lamp lit later than any of us. I have wondered what she reads by it.
final_ar: تترك ميريدا مصباحا مشتعلا لفترة أطول من أي منا. لقد تساءلتُ عما تقرأه على ضوئه.
reason: reads by it means by its light, not beside it.

source_en: The Knight buys from the Merchant often. I know what is bought. I do not know what is paid.
final_ar: يشتري الفارس من التاجر كثيرا. أعرف ما يُشترى. لا أعرف ما يُدفع.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: The Faith is to be praised, the Knight has returned. I have praised the Faith. I have praised, also, the Knight.
final_ar: الإيمان يستحق الثناء، لقد عاد الفارس. لقد ثنيتُ على الإيمان. لقد ثنيتُ، أيضا، على الفارس.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: The Knight is heavier on the stone than they were last week. The stones know.
final_ar: الفارس أثقل وزنا على الحجر مما كان عليه الأسبوع الماضي. الحجارة تعلم.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Valahk-Nor frightened children once. He frightens none tonight.
final_ar: أثار ڤالاك-نور رعب الأطفال ذات مرة. هو لا يرهب أحدا الليلة.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Far too many Nephilim have been let out of their coffins for my liking.
final_ar: أُطلق سراح عدد كبير جدا من النيفيليم من توابيتهم، وهذا لا يروق لي.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: We see the Knight visits the smith often. The smith is good at his work. For a wolf.
final_ar: نرى أن الفارس يزور الحداد كثيرا. الحداد بارع في عمله. بالنسبة لذئب.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Sometimes the Knight is still in the room after the Knight has left. The brothers do not speak of this.
final_ar: أحيانا يظل الفارس في الغرفة بعد أن يغادر الفارس. الإخوة لا يتحدثون عن هذا.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: Mereda was conscripted. The Faith was generous with the word.
final_ar: تم تجنيد ميريدا. كان الإيمان سخيا بالكلمة.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: The Commander has been in this Order for one hundred and twenty-six years. We have done the arithmetic.
final_ar: قضى القائد في هذه الجماعة مئة وستة وعشرين عاما. لقد أجرينا الحسابات.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: That Spire gnaws at Eden's veil. Divine protect us.
final_ar: ذلك البرج ينهش حجاب إيدن. فليحمنا الإله.
reason: Spire is the locked glossary term and the verb now agrees with it.

source_en: I went past the forge at the second hour of the morning. The smith was awake. The forge was cold. He was working anyway.
final_ar: مررتُ بالحدادة في الساعة الثانية من الصباح. كان الحداد مستيقظا. كانت الحدادة باردة. ومع ذلك، كان يعمل.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: The Knight is much in the Commander's company. The Commander treats the Knight as family.
final_ar: يقضي الفارس وقتا طويلا في رفقة القائد. يعامل القائد الفارس كفرد من عائلته.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: The smith toasted you with his wine last evening, Nephilim.
final_ar: نخبك الحداد بنبيذه في الأمس، يا نيفيليم.
reason: his wine was written as his rejection.

source_en: By the Divine, mustn't stop until the demons are finished.
final_ar: بالإله، لا يجوز التوقف حتى يتم القضاء على الشياطين.
reason: the draft mixed genders and missed the locked term for the Divine.

source_en: Gallant gives you missions others would refuse, Nephilim. There is a reading of this that flatters you, and another that ought to worry you.
final_ar: يمنحك قالانت مهاما قد يرفضها الآخرون، أيها النيفيليم. هناك قراءة لهذا الأمر تداعب غرورك، وأخرى ينبغي أن تقلقك.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: By the silver of his eye, as the silver of his steel.
final_ar: ببريق عينيه الفضي، كما بريق فولاذه الفضي.
reason: his steel was written as his bean.

source_en: For the Dead Gods cry, and the Fallen Lords lie...
final_ar: فالآلهة الميتة تصرخ، والأسياد الساقطون يرقدون…
reason: unified the refrain with its twin and stopped rendering Lords as gods.

source_en: Something walked past the door that night. I did not look. I have not opened that door since.
final_ar: شيء ما مرّ بجانب الباب في تلك الليلة. لم أنظر. ولم أفتح ذلك الباب منذ ذلك الحين.
reason: strip of decorative case-ending tanween only, exactly what the LOCKED diacritics rule allows; reading unchanged.

source_en: I crossed the Merchant's path at vigil last night. I will just say this. Be wary.
